(Bhāvā)gaṇeśadīkṣita
son of Bhavānī an. Viśvanātha Dīkṣita, grandson of Bhāvā Rāmakṛṣṇa an. Gaurī an. pupil of Vijñānabhikṣu.
--C. Tattvayāthārthyadīpana or Tattvasamāsa. L. 1757. Oudh XIV. 70 (Kapilasūtraṭīkā).
--C. on Yogasūtra. Hall p. 11. Rice 190.
--C. Ciccandrikā on Prabodhacandrodaya. Oxf. 141a.
--Samāsasaṅkhyāvṛtti. mīm. Mithilā.
--Sāṁkhyasāra. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 83 (no. 679).

(bhaṭṭa)gopāla
father of Śāradātanaya (a. of Bhāvaprakāśa. Pt.. GOS. I).

(bhaṭṭa)gopāla
q. in Smārtaprāyaścitta on the meaning of bhrUNahA.
See p. 4, Intro. to Kāvyaprakāśa with two C.s, TSS. edn.

(bhaṭṭa)govardhana_Paṇaka
--Vedāntasārasaṅgraha. a summary of Vedāntasāra of Sadānanda, in 200 verses. Hall p. 101.

(bhaṭṭa)govindasūri
mīmām3saka. father of Bhaṭṭa Vināyaka (a. of Bhāvasim3haprakriyā, IO. 906).

(bhaṭṭa)govinda
father of Bhaṭṭa Vināyaka (a. of Abhijñānaśākuntalaprākṛtacchāyā, Bikaner 3134).

(bhaṭṭa)govindarāja(deva)
poet.
Sbhv. 213. 627. 760. 767. 803. 906. 911. 998. 1410. 1419. 1520. 1522. 1599. 3107; Smv. p.. 57. 79. Śp. 87. 571. 925. 1031. 3261. 3457; Padyāmṛtataraṅgiṇī p. 67, verse 277; Vidagdhajanavallabhā of Vallabhadeva (p. 49, Kerala Uni. ms., see J. of Kerala Uni. Ori. Mss. Libr. XII. i-ii. p. 138); Rasikajīvana by Gadādhara, BORI. D. XII. 247. Śp. 181 is by Deveśvara in praise of Govindarāja.

(Bhaṭṭa)cuṇitaka
See Cūlitaka.

or Cuṇitaka poet. Sbhv. 2066. Skm. p. 158 (Lahore edn.); verse 1166 (Calcutta, edn. 1964).

(Bhaṭṭa)jagajjīvana
--Ajitodaya. Mahākāvya in (32 Sargas). Jodhpur 180.

(Bhaṭṭārakārya)jambhalajalendrasādhana

(Bhadanta)jñānavarman
Bud. poet. Śp. 971. Sbhv. 813.

(Bhaṭṭa)tauta
or Tota. 950-980 A. D. teacher of Abhinavagupta. ref. to in C. Locana on Dhvanyāloka etc.
--Kāvyakautuka.
See NCC. IV. p. 86b; also Kane, Skt. Poetics p.. 209-12.

(Bhaṭṭa)trivikrama
father of Lalla (a. of Jyotiṣaratnakośa. BORI. 27 of 1880-81 an. Dhīvṛddhidatantra. Bomb. Uni. 360).

(Bhāgavata)trivikrama
poet. Sbhv. 866. 1029.

(Bhāvasena)traividyadeva
--Viśvatattvaprakāśa. Arrah II. 72.

(Bhaṭṭa)dāmodara
father of Bhaṭṭa Mādhava (a. of Mām3saviveka, TD. 18950).

(Bhaṭṭa)dārila
great grandson of Vatsaśarman, who was also a Vedic scholar.
--C. Dārilabhaṣya on Kauśika (gṛhya)sutra. Av. Weber 1494. Extr.. included in Bloomfield's edition of the text. See NCC. V. p. 117. Ms. extending up to the end of Kāṇḍika 48 now in Tu7bingen University. [Page031-b]
Ed. together with offset copy of Ms. Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapitha, Poona, 1972.

(Bhaṭṭa)divākara
Kāś. Śaiva writer. Q. by Abhinavagupta in his Īśvarapratyabhijñāvivṛtivimarśinī. Kas. Texts 62. II. p. 145. 63. III. p. 388.

(Bhaṭṭa)dīptasvāmin
father of Śabarasvāmin (a. of C. Sarvārthalakṣaṇā on Liṅgānuśāsana of Harṣavardhana. Report X). See ibid. Extr. XXXIX.

(Bhaṭṭa)narasiṃha
(C. 1600 A. D.) follower of Bhāṭṭaschool.
--C. Bhāṣya(pra)dīpa on Mīmām3sā bhāṣya. MT. 3773. Trav. Uni. 345B. T. 1185.
Perhaps identical with Bhaṭṭa Narasim3ha, a. of C. on Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa of Bhoja.

(Bhaṭṭa)narasiṃha
--C. on Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa. MT. 2499. TCD. 1211.

(Bhaṭṭa)nāga
or Nāgānanda.
--Svarūpapraveśikā or Svarūpaprakāśikā or Parāpraveśikā. [Page001-b]
Adyar D. X. 955-57. MD. 15328. MT. 2159 (with C.).
Pt.. edn. ascribes the work to Kṣemarāja.

(Bhaṭṭoji)nāganātha
a. of a work which was criticised by Veṅkaṭārya alias Śrīnivāsa in his Nāganāthoktidhikkāra. MD. 5330. [Page004-b]

(Bhaṭṭoji)nāganāthoktidhikkāra
by Veṅkaṭārya alias Śrīnivāsa. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 41. MD. 5330.

(Bhaṭṭa)nāgeśa

(Bhaṭṭa)nārāyaṇa
